assessments.title: Week 7 average-rate formative reasoning
assessments.instructions: Independently show a complete difference quotient, units and interpretation for each 5-point item. 1: A runner travels 3 miles at 20 minutes and 9 miles at 80 minutes. Find average speed in miles/hour. 2: For f(x)=x², calculate average rate from x=1 to x=4. 3: A tank falls from 80 L at minute 2 to 56 L at minute 8. Interpret average rate. 4: A table is (0,4),(2,8),(5,23). Compare average rates on intervals [0,2] and [2,5] and explain if constant.

rubricCriteria.description: Correct signed quotient, conversion and contextual units.

assessments.title: Week 7 transfer and cumulative rate checkpoint
assessments.instructions: Work independently. 1 (5): Compute average rate from (1,12) to (5,36) with units if x is weeks and y is dollars. 2 (5): For g(x)=x²+1 find average rate on [2,5]. 3 (5): A battery falls from 90% to 54% in 6 hours; give the average change in percentage points/hour. 4 (5): Explain using two intervals whether h(t)=4t+10 has constant rate and identify its initial value.
